description: This file defines the ModuleNode class, which extends PcbNode and models a module with pads and a reference point in a PCB design context.

classes.name: ModuleNode
classes.description: Represents a PCB module node with pads, a position, and a reference identifier, providing methods to access these properties and check connections.

methods.name: ModuleNode
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ModuleNode with a name, index, and children objects, extracting pads, position, and reference from provided data.

methods.name: getReference
methods.description: Returns the reference string associated with this module node.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ModuleNode, including its reference and the number of pads.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the given point is connected to any pad of this module considering the module's position.
